UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Avoid purple-gradient AI slop.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.

Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy: Base night canvas (z-0) -> Procedural web canvas & strands (z-10) -> Ambient particle dust & mist (z-15) -> Photoreal SVG/Canvas Orb Weaver entity (z-20) -> Dewdrop navigation nodes (z-30) -> Cinematic overlay / Page panels (z-40) -> HUD & Audio/Status controllers (z-50).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). Optical clarity with subtle border-white/10 and high dark contrast.

You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). This breaks transforms and framer-motion animations. Specify individual transitions (e.g., 'transition: color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease').
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in CSS. This disrupts human natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or crisp geometric button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react or clean SVG glyphs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Containers with border must have padding on text content (p-6, p-8, p-12).
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom spider-reticle cursor, selection states, and dew shimmer elevate this into an Awwwards winner.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or surfaces with content underneath.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='nav-droplet-about', data-testid='timeline-item-0').

web_canvas.description: Procedural HTML5 Canvas rendering a complex orb-weaver spiral web (24-32 radial lines + 18 logarithmic spiral arcs). Threads possess gentle catenary sag and respond with sinusoidal vibration when cursor moves near.
web_canvas.thread_physics: Subtle wind sway (sinusoidal offset with Perlin noise or composite sine waves: speed 0.0015, amplitude 4px). Hovering radial spokes causes resonant string vibration.

spider_entity.description: Photoreal vector/canvas Orb Weaver spider (Neoscona/Araneus). Distinct anatomy: 2-part body (cephalothorax with 8 glowing ocelli eyes, patterned abdomen with amber/ochre markings, 8 jointed segmented legs with pedipalps).
spider_entity.cursor_tracking_behavior: EERIE OCULAR & HEAD TRACKING: Spider remains anchored to the web hub. Cephalothorax tilts subtly towards clientX/clientY (max rotation ±14deg). The 4 front legs perform micro-breathing twitches. Spider does NOT leave the center until a dewdrop is clicked.
spider_entity.pounce_mechanic: ON DROPLET CLICK: The spider snaps into high-velocity predatory lunge toward the clicked droplet node (320ms spring physics, rapid leg stepping, web strand tension jolt). After striking the droplet, droplet bursts with radiant rippling light, triggering the full-screen cinematic transition into the target page.

dewdrops_navigation.description: Glimmering water droplets suspended on specific spiral junctions of the web.
dewdrops_navigation.visual_treatment: Convex glass bead with specular white reflection point, refraction distortion, and pulsating soft cyan-amber aura. On hover, the droplet expands, the label blooms in high-contrast monospaced capital letters, and a silk vibration sound/haptic cue triggers.

visual_enhancers.ambient_nocturnal_atmosphere: Gentle floating moonlit dust motes (canvas particles), subtle vignette border, ambient audio toggle (soothing nocturnal forest night crickets / distant breeze audio synthesized with Web Audio API or gentle sound wave toggle).

home.title: The Weaver's Hub
home.concept: Pure full-viewport immersive nocturnal sanctum. Zero scrollbars. Minimal HUD in corners (Brandon D. Phillips / Senior Full-Stack Engineer / 6 Long-Term Tenures / Sound Control / Experience Mode toggle). Glimmering dewdrops acting as the organic spatial menu.
home.interaction: Move mouse to explore cursor tracking of the spider's eyes & leg tension. Click any dewdrop to trigger the predatory strike and page warp.

about.title: Entomology of an Engineer
